title: DAgger twins on the test links, once: net2 on net1 v9 against neto2 on neto1 v2, 11 policies
description: The one test-link run of the learned net2 and its learned neto2 twin. Both are round 25's online DAgger recipe (round 18's gate3 students, teacher gain 0.5, training seeds 1 to 3): net2 on net1 v9 reading the means (exp-net2-r25-v9-249, r25-means) and neto2 on neto1 v2, the same 27 LCFs with one value each (exp-neto2-r26-v2-254), with the rule on neto1 v2 at u = 0.25 (r26-u0.25) or 0.375 (r26-u0.375) as teacher. Each arm's iteration was chosen on the validation links at campaign seed 21 by its five-family mean over the three training seeds (exp-dagger-twins-iter-val-256): r25-means after iteration 19, r26-u0.25 after 39, r26-u0.375 after 59; experiments/dagger-twins-confirm-val.json checks those choices at campaign seeds 11 and 31 before this runs. Every training seed of each arm runs here beside BBRv3 and, as reference lines only, the rule on net1 v9 at u = 0.25 (rule-v9) and on neto1 v2 at u = 0.375 (rule-v2), on the 27 test links: the five families (training seed 13, others 31), the held-out competitors (BBRv3 and Westwood) and 2 and 4 copies, as the test of r18e05 did (experiments/net2-test-r18e05.json). Nothing is chosen or tuned on these links.
prepare: N9="$IN/v9/$(cat "$IN/v9/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; N2="$IN/v2/$(cat "$IN/v2/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v9" "$N9" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v2" "$N2" --u 0.375; P=(--policy "rule-v9=$OUT/v9/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v2=$OUT/v2/rule-u0.375.onnx"); for d in r q x; do (cd "$IN/$d" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); done; for f in "$IN"/x/ppo-r25-means-s*-i19.onnx "$IN"/q/ppo-r26-u0.25-s*-i39.onnx "$IN"/x/ppo-r26-u0.375-s*-i59.onnx; do n="$(basename "$f" .onnx)"; n="${n#ppo-}"; it="${n##*-}"; b="${n%-*}"; P+=(--policy "${b%-*}-$it-${b##*-}=$f"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 22 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" test 13 31 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60" --split test --family held-competitors --duration-ms 60000 --seed 31 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-held-competitors-60"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split test --duration-ms 30000 --seed 31 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart held-competitors-60 copies-30s && uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" rule-v9
